concerns.text: T014 (imputation) is scheduled BEFORE T015 (merge/exclusion). T015 explicitly excludes samples missing critical environmental metadata (FR-012). Imputing data (T014) before excluding these samples violates the 'Producer before consumer' and 'Data Hygiene' principles, as it risks obscuring missingness or imputing values for samples that should be discarded. T014 must be moved to AFTER T015.

T017 (validation report) depends on T016 (pathway aggregation). However, T016 (aggregation) is not a strict prerequisite for the 'Independent Test' of US1 (merged CSV with ≥50 rows). The validation report (T017) should logically validate the raw merged output (T015) before aggregation occurs, or T016 should be moved to US2 (Modeling) where dimensionality reduction is actually required for the model. Currently, T016 blocks the validation of the core US1 deliverable.

T007 (schema creation) and T008 (env config) are listed in Phase 2 but marked as incomplete/missing. T005 (synthetic data generator) and T012 (data ingestion) depend on these schemas and configurations to function correctly. T007 and T008 must be moved to the very top of Phase 2 (or Phase 1) to ensure they are completed BEFORE any data generation or ingestion tasks (T005, T012) are attempted.

T031 (overlap statistics) depends on T016 (pathway aggregation). T016 is currently in Phase 3 (US1). If T016 is delayed or moved (see concern above), T031 becomes blocked. Furthermore, T031 depends on the model output (T024) to know which features are 'top', but the task description implies it uses aggregated features. The dependency chain is ambiguous: does T031 run on the model's top features (requiring T024) or on the aggregated features (requiring T016)? The order must be clarified to ensure T024 (model) and T016 (aggregation) are both complete before T031.

T005 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T007 (schema) and T008 (env config) to define the output format and data paths. If T007/T008 are not completed, T005 cannot run safely. The [P] tag is misleading until the foundational schema/config tasks are resolved.
